stemMd: Every sensor that passes calibration is marked green. Some green sensors are awaiting installation. Which statement must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A sensor without a green mark has not passed calibration.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Every green sensor has passed calibration.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Some sensors that failed calibration await installation.

explanationMd: Passing calibration implies a green mark. Its contrapositive is no green mark implies not having passed. The statement about some green sensors waiting adds no necessary connection between calibration and installation.

distractorRationale.c: Green marking may have other causes; the implication cannot be reversed.
distractorRationale.b: The waiting subset of green sensors need not include all calibrated sensors.
distractorRationale.e: Installation status is not restricted this way.
distractorRationale.d: The premises do not identify failed sensors in the waiting group.
